tasks.label: claude-manager: Publish to stable
tasks.detail: Build the committed HEAD into the installed app (%LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-manager\app). Refuses to run while the app is open.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Publish to stable (dry run)
tasks.detail: Show what would be published — which sha, and whether the dev tree is dirty — without writing anything.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Run stable app
tasks.detail: Launch the installed Electron app from the published payload.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Run shell against this checkout
tasks.detail: Iterate on the Electron shell itself using this repo's build (CM_APP_DIR). Run 'pnpm build' first after server changes.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Install branded runtime (after Electron upgrade)
tasks.detail: Copy Electron to shell/ as claude-manager.exe with the icon embedded. Needed once per Electron version — this is what makes taskbar pinning keep the icon.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Create Start-menu shortcut
tasks.detail: Point a Start-menu (add --desktop for Desktop) shortcut at the installed payload's Electron.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Migrate .data -> AppData (dry run)
tasks.detail: Preview the one-time split of a single-root .data store into data/ + config/. Copies only; never deletes the source.

tasks.label: claude-manager: Dev server (pnpm dev)
tasks.detail: The hot-reload dev instance on :4319 — unaffected by the stable app on :4318.
